{{Top|leg}}

The '''Highland Clans''' were one of the groupings of [[S'kytri]] clans that ruled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye/Legends|Skye]]. The Highlanders and [[Lowland Clans|Lowlanders]] combined made up two-thirds of Skye's population. They inhabited the [[Highlands (Skye)|Highlands]] region of Skye where they lived in mountaintop cities and citadels. The governing body of the Highland Clans was the [[Supreme Council of the Highland Clans]]. The Highland and Lowland Clans took turns governing Skye by voting a member of their respective strata to the office of [[Patriarch (Skye)|Patriarch]] every forty-two years. For many years, the Highland, Lowland, and [[Outland Clan]]s lived in relative peace and depended on each other economically. At the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Klarymére]] was the [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the Highland Clans and the Patriarch of Skye. It was during his reign that the mad [[Geneticist/Legends|genetic]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Zeta Magnus]] arrived on Skye and transformed the Outlanders into a [[mutant]] army and turned them against the other clans. The Highland Clans, dependent on the Outland Clans for agricultural products, began to decline due to starvation and attacks from the Outlanders. When a team of [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] arrived to free Skye from Zeta Magnus, the Highland and Lowland Clans united to drive the scourge from their world. In the ensuing [[Battle of Skye|battle]], the Highlanders suffered an untold number of casualties. Following the death of Klarymére, [[Aragh]] became Patriarch of the Highland Clans. Following the Clone Wars, Skye would be oppressed by [[Kharys]], a former Highlander who was trained as a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and appointed as the [[Magister of Skye|Majestrix]] of Skye. The Supreme Council of the Highland Clans would lead a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebels]] to her [[Kharys' fortress|castle]] where [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] would defeat her and free the S'kytri from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].
